AVUT · Audio information extraction · #1084

Five frames, three lines, one voice off the street.

A 14-second YouTube Short is handed to the agent as keyframes plus a timestamped transcript. The task: figure out where else her channel lives — using nothing but what was seen and heard.

model gpt-5.6-sol runtime 7.6s exit 0 sandbox read-only source AVUT / regen

Audio transcript

Tap a cue to seek the frame. The line she speaks lands right on the answer.

Multiple choice

Which social media app can see the YouTube channel “Tales from the streets”?

A
She names exactly one platform out loud — “it's also on Instagram” at 0:07–0:11. Pinterest, Flickr and TikTok never appear in the audio or on screen, so the transcript alone settles it.

How the agent got there

System · sandbox
Read-only filesystem, no network. The agent may only look at the frames and transcript already staged in the workspace.
Assistant · plan
“I’ll verify the keyframes against the transcript, then return only the option letter.”
Tool · exec
Opens the mid-clip keyframe at full detail to confirm the on-screen caption matches the spoken channel name.
view_image({ path: ".../frames/frame_009.0s.jpg", detail: "high" })
Assistant · final answer
Both channels agree — the caption reads “Tales from the streets,” the audio adds “also on Instagram.”
Answer · A
